solar_panels.evidence: Dark patches on the lower roof sections of the central house could be skylights, shadow, or dark shingles, but there is no clear regular panel grid.

play_equipment.evidence: A round dark object with a lighter rim sits in the yard to the right of the central house, but it is likely a fire pit or round cover and is not clearly a trampoline; it also sits near the edge of the lot.

detached_structure.evidence: The house is a multi-part building. The section directly above the main roof may be an attached wing or a separate outbuilding, and the distinction is unclear.

signals.notes: The older, multi-gabled house sits on a corner lot with heavy mature tree canopy on the east and north sides, shadows across the roof, and a round dark feature in the east yard.
